message:
test(ka-pc r2): same-key re-keep counted at once (shared fix a7773e6), and four test errors fixed

- the 31 s wait before re-leasing the same PC key is gone: after a crash, after EndAll and after an eviction the
  same key is kept again at once and counted (the r1 FINDING line is a check now)
- managed: Activate and Release back to back (20 ms later the warm lease had already connected); a Release refused
  while the cancelled activation's granted session is held is measured as model A -- the Host ends that session on
  control silence (~10 s), checked within 15 s
- shell: the recent order read after the UI has run the posted connect; the failed activation read from the log
  after the tap (not the previous session's line); the fallback looked for by its own line ('did not close in
  time'), not by the shell's announcement; card details read AFTER the wait (argument order is unspecified)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
